purpose: Portable contract for isolated repository workspaces used by task execution.

root.description: Logical root only; never publish a concrete user home.

invariants: Concurrent tasks must not share a mutable worktree unless the workflow explicitly declares shared isolation.
A worktree path must be relative or opaque; concrete user-home paths are runtime state, not portable task data.
A repository branch must be recorded before an agent starts modifying files.
Secrets and ignored files may be copied only through an explicit allowlist and never into public artifacts.
